verdict.rationale: Airweave documents first-party framework integrations, including an official @airweave/vercel-ai-sdk package with an airweaveSearch tool and a llama-index-tools-airweave AirweaveToolSpec, plus Pipedream and Sim integrations. That clearly covers dropping its search layer into agent frameworks. Of the frameworks the story names, only the Vercel AI SDK is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented LangChain, LangGraph and CrewAI integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the framework packages.
